subject: Production: BrightScope websocket chunk gaps causing high latency and error rate
messages:
From: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@brightscope.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>; support@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: [PROD] Realtime feed: long silent chunks + websocket timeouts (impacts user sessions)

Hi Sofia / Redwood team,

We're seeing a spike in silent chunks and websocket timeouts on our production realtime endpoint (model: redwood-3b-live). Since ~08:30 PST this morning ~40% of live requests either stall for 10-30s with intermittent partial tokens, or the WS connection resets with a 1006 close. Error rate on our side jumped from 0.3% to 6.8% in the 1h window. Latency p95 has drifted from ~120ms to ~2.3s for streamed responses.

I've attached a websocket dump and a screenshot of our dashboard. Included below are two example session IDs and the request trace ids we captured:
- session_id: sess-7f3c2a34
- session_id: sess-9b1d5e21
- trace ids: trace-a8e7, trace-a8e8

This is customer-facing traffic — a handful of paying users are getting blank responses during demos. Can you confirm if there's a platform-side incident or if this looks like a customer-side integration issue? We need either a mitigation or a timeline.

Thanks,
Anna Brooks
Head of Integrations, BrightScope
BrightScope Inc.
Attachments: ws-dump-brightscope-20261203.log, screenshot-timeouts.png
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@brightscope.ai>, BrightScope Support <support@brightscope.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, SRE Team <sre@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: [PROD] Realtime feed: long silent chunks + websocket timeouts (impacts user sessions)

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick heads-up and the artifacts. I'm escalating this to SRE and our realtime lead (cc'd). Initial triage questions while they dig in:
- Can you confirm whether the affected sessions used streaming=true + chunked transfer or a streaming SSE/WebSocket variant?
- Do you see the same behavior across regions or only us-west?
- Are there client-side retries enabled (we've seen some client retry loops exacerbate chunking behavior)?

We will pull the server-side traces for trace-a8e7 / trace-a8e8 and get back with an initial short-term mitigation within 60 minutes. If this is production impacting a large subset of requests we'll treat as a Sev-1.

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Reliability Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, SRE Team <sre@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: [PROD] Realtime feed: long silent chunks + websocket timeouts (impacts user sessions)

Adding an update from infra playback of the dump (preliminary):
- The websocket connections show a pattern of keepalive/heartbeat ACKs from the proxy, then a ~15-25s gap where the backend does not push any chunked frames and the client eventually hits a read timeout.
- There are client-side reconnects that reopen sessions; on a small subset we observe chunk reassembly failures reported by the proxy (partial chunk + missing EOM).
- No obvious model OOMs or GPU errors in the window; CPU on the frontend shards spiked at the same time, consistent with increased batching backlog.

Immediate mitigations we can push as an emergency config change (requires infra ok):
1) Reduce the chunk idle threshold from 20s -> 8s to cause an earlier fallback and shorter perceived latency for stalled streams.
2) Enable a temporary polling fallback for BrightScope's routes (polling avoids the WS chunking path).
3) Temporarily bump frontend shard autoscale targets to absorb backlog while we root cause.

We need approval to schedule an emergency hotfix deploy (config toggles + autoscale bump) and an exec-level decision on whether to offer BrightScope credits for the incident window. I'll assemble logs and link the Jira ticket.

- Soojin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@brightscope.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Escalation: BrightScope production streaming degradation — request for exec support and hotfix approval

Marissa / David — quick executive summary and ask:

Impact:
- BrightScope (production customer, mid-market) reporting ~40% of streaming sessions experiencing stalls or WS resets since 08:30 PST.
- Error rate increased to ~6.8% and p95 latency for streamed responses rose to ~2.3s. This is impacting demos and paying customer workflows.

Preliminary cause (SRE):
- Proxy/front-end chunking path shows intermittent chunk reassembly failures during periods of increased batching backlog. Not seeing model crashes; appears to be an interaction between batching/backpressure and chunk idle thresholds.

Proposed immediate actions (SRE recommended):
- Emergency config change: reduce chunk idle threshold to 8s (short-term), enable polling fallback for BrightScope routes, and increase frontend autoscale targets to clear backlog. (Requires infra/fleet permission for hotfix deploy.)
- Open JIRA: JIRA-INF-1298 (triage + RCA).
- Customer outreach: white-glove support call + incident timeline + offer up to 25% service credit for the 08:30-10:15 PST impacted window if RCA confirms platform cause.

Asks:
1) Approval to proceed with hotfix deploy now (config toggles + autoscale bump).
2) Approval to commit to a customer-facing credit (up to 25%) if we confirm platform fault after RCA.
3) Allocate a senior infra engineer for a 3hr warroom and a pair for the weekend RCA as needed.

I'll run the customer call in 30 minutes if we get approvals and will make sure we have a succinct comms draft for legal/finance review.

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Reliability Manager
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@brightscope.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: BrightScope production streaming degradation — request for exec support and hotfix approval

Thanks Sofia — approved to proceed with the emergency hotfix and autoscale bump. Please coordinate with infra to get the toggle out immediately and confirm the rollback plan. Approve offering a customer credit up to 25% pending the RCA.

I'll assign a senior infra lead for the 3hr warroom and approve the weekend RCA pair. Keep me posted on the customer call outcome and send the comms draft prior to sending.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
